question: Which of the following is NOT a transition metal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mg.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The transition metal elements are d-block elements.
 
• The d-block elements are formed due to the addition of the last electrons in the d-sublevel of an atom.
 
• The series of the d-block element is classified as 3d, 4d, 5d, and 6d series.
 
• They are good conductors of heat and electricity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__s-block element:__

__
 
• The elements in which the valence electron is present in the outermost s-orbital of an atom are called s-block elements.
 
• The elements of groups 1 and 2 are called s-block elements.

p-block elements:__

__
 
• The elements in which the valence electron is present in the outermost p-orbital of an atom are called p-block elements.
 
• The elements of groups 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18 are the p-block elements except for the helium atom.

f-block elements:__

 
• The elements in which the valence electron is present in the outermost f-orbital of an atom are called f-block elements.
 
• The elements of lanthanide and actinide series are the f-block elements.
